title: Notifications
channels.explain: Send notifications to other places. What you enter here (addresses, tokens) is stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.empty: No channel yet. Notifications stay in your inbox.
channels.name: Name
channels.private: Addresses inside your own network are refused unless the server administrator allows them.
channels.secret: Signing secret of this webhook. Receivers use it to check that a message really comes from Armadok. It is shown only now.
rules.explain: Choose, for each kind of notification, where it goes and from which severity. Without a choice, it goes to your inbox.
